amount_eq.description: Filter payment links by exact amount; must be greater than zero.

amount_gt.description: Filter payment links by amounts greater than this value; must be greater than zero.

amount_lt.description: Filter payment links by amounts less than this value; must be greater than zero.

filter_by.description: Date range used to filter payment links. Allowed values: Date.Today, Date.ThisWeek, Date.ThisMonth, Date.ThisQuarter, Date.ThisHalfYear, Date.ThisYear, Date.PreviousDay, Date.PreviousWeek, Date.PreviousMonth, Date.PreviousQuarter, Date.PreviousHalfYear, Date.PreviousYear, Date.CustomDate, Date.Last_7_Days, Date.Last_30_Days, Date.Last_90_Days.

page.description: Page number of the payment links list (e.g. 1).

per_page.description: Number of payment links per page (default 25, max 200).

search_text.description: Search payment links by text like payment link ID, email, or reference.

sort_column.description: Column to sort payment links by. Confirmed value: created_time.

sort_order.description: Sort direction. Use A for ascending or D for descending.

status.description: Filter payment links by status. Use Status.All on its own, or a comma-separated list of Status.Active, Status.Paid, Status.Canceled, and Status.Expired.
